```powershell
function Test-IPv4 {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Address
    )

    # Regex breakdown:
    # ^ and $ : Start/End of string
    # (?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3} : Matches first 3 octets + dot
    #     25[0-5]          -> 250-255
    #     |2[0-4][0-9]     -> 200-249
    #     |[01]?[0-9][0-9]? -> 0-199 (Note: This allows leading zeros, so we refine below)
    # To strictly forbid leading zeros for numbers > 0 and allow '0' exactly:
    # Use: (25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])

    $pattern = '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])$'

    if ($Address -match $pattern) {
        return $true
    }
    return $false
}
```
